targets.body:
gkMasterVol = kNorm
      ; GLITCH v2 (2026-07-15): per-effect instant-trigger targets — expression
      ; pedal = instant trigger (stutter.orc INTEGRATION NOTES item F). No
      ; branch reads gkGLITCH_chance any more (globals.orc keeps the decl;
      ; the CHASE BLISS clock still writes gkGLITCH_bpm).
gkBBcut_expr = kNorm
gkRPT_expr = kNorm
gkCHP_expr = kNorm
gkRVS_expr = kNorm
gkIMP_expr = kNorm
gkVOLpedal = kNorm

targets.label: TAPE transport: heel = play, toe = stop (spin-up on release)
targets.body:
; TAPE transport: heel = play, toe = stop (spin-up on release)
        gkTapeExpr = kNorm
gkSemi = kNorm * 24 - 12
gkGPSsemis = kNorm * 24 - 12
gkFormantShift = kNorm * 24 - 12
gkFormsShift = kNorm * 24 - 12

targets.label: BIN REDUCTION contrast: heel (0) = extreme crush, toe (1) = transparent/emphasis

targets.body:

        gkBcPedal = kNorm

targets.label: H90 expression sweep. Bass mode = up-only wammy (unison..+octave); surf/PITCH = full +/-12 (unchanged).
targets.body:
; H90 expression sweep. Bass mode = up-only wammy (unison..+octave);
        ; surf/PITCH = full +/-12 (unchanged).
        if (gkPresetBank == 1) then
          gkSemiH90 = kNorm * 12
        else
          gkSemiH90 = kNorm * 24 - 12
        endif
gkSemiPF = kNorm * 24 - 12

; Leslie speed
        gkLeslieSpeedAcc = kNorm

targets.label: BLOOPER: manual override of event probability + pitch, centred at rest (0.5 = pure generative, matching id 66's toe/heel polarity). Below rest scales density/pitch down from whatever the generative engine (gkBLP_Scat + motion) is producing; above rest scales it up, up to full every-tick coverage at 100%. See effects/blooper.orc PEDAL DESIGN (2026-08-23) for the full formula.
targets.body:

        gkFrzExpr = kNorm

targets.label: HYPERGUITAR PITCH — the guitar's pitch shifter at 100% wet, with the pedal driving the interval directly. Heel/toe span the lane's range (default +/-12 semitones); the value is relayed to the Bela as /hg/pedal by instr 98, which is the ONLY consumer.  This exists so the pedal CLAIMS on engage like every other effect. Before it, the engine forwarded the pedal to the guitar unconditionally, so the treadle drove the guitar AND whatever else owned it (menu-0 presets point it at target 30, gkMasterVol) at the same time -- reported as "the exp pedal is still on volume, it needs to come off volume like normal functionality".
targets.body:
; HYPERGUITAR PITCH — the guitar's pitch shifter at 100% wet, with the
        ; pedal driving the interval directly. Heel/toe span the lane's range
        ; (default +/-12 semitones); the value is relayed to the Bela as
        ; /hg/pedal by instr 98, which is the ONLY consumer.
        ;
        ; This exists so the pedal CLAIMS on engage like every other effect.
        ; Before it, the engine forwarded the pedal to the guitar
        ; unconditionally, so the treadle drove the guitar AND whatever else
        ; owned it (menu-0 presets point it at target 30, gkMasterVol) at the
        ; same time -- reported as "the exp pedal is still on volume, it needs
        ; to come off volume like normal functionality".
        gkHgPedal = kNorm
